title: Discovery Wildlife Park
specs: Sanctuary for orphaned animals that cannot be released into the wild
Educational focus with bear safety and animal presentations
Wolf walk requires age 16+, able to walk 15 minutes unassisted, closed footwear, long pants, no wheelchairs/walkers/canes
Bear encounters require minimum age 8, children 8-12 must be accompanied by adult
Children 2 and under must be held at all times during animal encounters
Kindergarten to Grade 12 groups can book educational hands on opportunity for $1/person
Maximum 4 people per golf cart; carts reserved for seniors or disabled on weekends/holidays

blurb: Guests can visit the wildlife park to see and learn about orphaned animals that cannot be released into the wild. The park offers educational presentations, animal encounters, and a campground with cabins and powered sites. Evening animal experiences and photo opportunities with various animals are available by advance booking.
